status: geometry only; never printed, assembled or powered

placement.frame: x forward (toes, head), y left, z up. The left leg is the one built from the mirrored yoke, on the torso cradle at y = +57.
placement.servo_in_cradle: Case bottom on the plate, long sides between the rails, centred along the rails, output shaft away from the plate.
placement.roll_servo_flip: true puts the hip roll shaft at the upper end of the torso cradle.
placement.pitch_servo_flip: true puts the hip pitch shaft at the lower end of the yoke cradle.
placement.knee_servo_flip: false puts the knee shaft at the far (distal) end of the thigh.
placement.horn_side: The printed blank sits on the outer face of the horn, so the horn screw is reached through the 8 mm hole from the far side.
placement.yoke_face: The roll horn meets the yoke face at yoke z = 0; the wall and the pitch cradle extend forward from it.
placement.thigh_face: 'rail' puts the hip horn on the face that carries the rails, so the knee servo lies beside the hip pitch servo and the foot is nearer the body. 'flat' puts it on the flat face, stacking thigh, knee servo and shin outward. Both are checked; this value picks the one the robot description uses.
placement.shin_face: The shin blank is symmetric; the face towards the knee servo meets the horn and the foot points +x.
placement.neutral: Thighs straight down, shins vertical, soles level, horns at mid travel.
placement.board: UNO Q long side along x, centred between the deck rails, on spacers; Braccio shield stacked on top.

findings.text: left_roll_servo overlaps the torso deck by 1054.7 mm3 at its centred position in the cradle: the case end and the upper mounting ear run 4.0 mm into the 4 mm deck plate (z 0.0 to 4.0 mm).
right_roll_servo overlaps the torso deck by 1054.7 mm3 at its centred position in the cradle: the case end and the upper mounting ear run 4.0 mm into the 4 mm deck plate (z 0.0 to 4.0 mm).
The UNO Q centred between the deck rails overlaps the neck root by 49.0 mm3 (3.29 mm along x). Moving the board 3.25 mm forward clears it and keeps it on the deck.
The Braccio shield above the board overlaps the neck by 26.3 mm3 at the same position.

On all 6 cradles one of the two cable ties crosses the output shaft: the slot pair at 10.92 mm from the cradle centre is in line with the shaft at 10.75 mm (SR431; depends on the assumed shaft position). Only the tie at the far end can go over the case.
Every servo case fits between its rails with 0.5 mm each side, sits fully on its plate, and all tie slots are open.
All six horn screw holes are on their shaft axes and a screwdriver has a free path to each at the neutral pose.
Legs straight down: the centre of mass is 8.77 mm outside the support polygon of the two feet (behind the heels); it falls backward.
With the thighs swung back 45.0 degrees and the knees turned the other way to keep the soles level, the centre of mass is 37.3 mm inside the polygon. This is the stand pose.

On one foot the centre of mass is 61.91 mm outside the foot at the stand pose and still 38.42 mm outside with the stance hip rolled up to 30 degrees: there is no ankle, so hip roll tilts the body instead of shifting it. It only comes over the foot with the stance hip rolled 77.0 degrees, which lays the body on its side.
